notes: وروى بعضهم introduces a different transmitter for the same saying, so the first chain is a variant group; the main chain is the حدثنا بذلك line.
قال قال أبو بكر is a commentator's remark, not a link (rule 6), and the Abu Bakr named there is not added.
The narrator's words كان ... ولم يذكر فيه عن أبي سعيد are a comparison of versions, not a route.

fixes.reason: The text says the second version does not name Abu Said, yet the K6I sequence lists him as the last link of the chain.

evidence.quote: ولم يذكر فيه عن أبي سعيد
أبو سعيد سعد بن مالك بن سنان الخدري
